desc:
Welcome to Trains vs Cars Epic!

Here's a mess of things you can do here:
🚂Park on the tracks and see if a train shows up
🚞Explore a quite large map with 3 different active mainlines
🏁Race your friends, or crash into them and explode their cars!
🚔Spawn a police car and rid the city of vandals, pizza stealing rodents and whatever else your friends are

✈Pretend your car is an airplane via ramps, rough railroad crossings & dangerous maneuvers at high speeds
🚦Ignore traffic signals and disintegrate your vehicle
💥Start a volunteer demolition derby by ramming onto your friends' cars!
🚃Do a little railfanning and spot manifest, intermodal, tanker, coal, and even the occasional steam trains that rumble through town!
▶Still reading this?  How about you just press play and see for yourself, okay?
